template.name: MedicationFreeTextSig
template.desc: The template is available to explicitly identify the free text Sig within each medication. An example free text sig: Thyroxin 150 ug, take one tab by mouth every morning.

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="SBADM" (CodeSystem: HL7ActClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.6 STATIC) (CONF:1198-32770).

attribute.name: moodCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @moodCode, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet MoodCodeEvnInt urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.11.20.9.18 STATIC 2011-04-03 (CONF:1198-32771).

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] templateId (CONF:1198-32753) such that it

element.name: cda:code
element.desc:
SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] code (CodeSystem: LOINC urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.1) (CONF:1198-32775).
a. This code SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @code="76662-6" Instructions Medication (CONF:1198-32780).
b. This code SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" (CodeSystem: LOINC urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.6.1 STATIC) (CONF:1198-32781).

element.name: cda:reference
element.desc:
This text SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] reference (CONF:1198-32755).
Reference into the section/text to a tag that only contains free text sig.

attribute.name: value
attribute.desc: This reference SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] @value (CONF:1198-32756).

element.assert: This reference/@value SHALL begin with a '#' and SHALL point to its corresponding narrative (using the approach defined in CDA Release 2, section 4.3.5.1)

element.name: cda:manufacturedProduct
element.desc: This consumable SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] manufacturedProduct (CONF:1198-32777).

element.name: cda:manufacturedLabeledDrug
element.desc: This manufacturedProduct SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] manufacturedLabeledDrug (CONF:1198-32778).

attribute.name: nullFlavor
attribute.desc: This manufacturedLabeledDrug SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @nullFlavor="NA" Not Applicable (CONF:1198-32779).
